PhotoMaster uses utif2 4.1.0 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2017 Photopea) to read DNG IFDs, OpcodeList and DefaultCrop tags.
utif2 bundles pako 1.x (MIT, Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn).
Both packages are used unmodified. Only TIFF structure parsing is used; no image data is decoded by utif2.
Source: https://github.com/photopea/UTIF.js, https://github.com/nodeca/pako
Licenses: LICENSE-utif2.txt and LICENSE-pako.txt in this directory.
